searchText: MSRP $825,324. All New 2026 Entegra Anthem Model 44D Bath & ½ Model for sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. Optional Features 12.5KW Generator Starlink Satellite Double Lav Sink in Main Bathroom Theater Seats  This RV rides on a Freightliner chassis, 15,000 lb. hitch and is powered by a turbocharged 450HP Cummins ISL diesel engine with side mounted radiator, 1,250-lb. ft. torque and an Allison 3000 series transmission. This luxury bath & 1/2 diesel motor coach measures approximately 44 feet 11 inches in length and is backed by Entegra Coach's superior 2-Year/24K Mile Limited Coach & 5-Year Limited Structural Warranties. Features that further set the Anthem apart include the Aqua-Hot® 450D hydronic water and heating system with in-floor heat throughout and engine preheat, Blind Spot Monitoring and adaptive cruise control system displayed on the digital dash screen, integrated camera control, Xite™ 360° HD digital camera system, Premier Bus Armor 8” stainless-steel trim, porcelain tile backsplashes, decorative ceiling treatment with integrated accent lighting, USB/110 outlets, LED marker lights and turn signals, power rear engine door with push button control and much more.
